title: A sign monomial correlation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, and at each coordinate $j\in\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ choose a probability mass function $p_j$ on pairs of signs and a real number $\rho_j$. Suppose that under $p_j$ each sign has mean zero, while the product of the two signs has mean $\rho_j$. For a set $S\subseteq\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ and a coordinate $i$, take a tuple of pairs with the independent product distribution, form the product of its left signs over $S$, and multiply by its right sign at $i$. The expectation is $\rho_i$ if $S=\{i\}$ and is zero otherwise.

zero mean for each right sign
the mean of the sign product at each coordinate equals its parameter
